The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 02031 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 3 October - the folder's feast day. Captioned Dionisy and filed under Category:Dionysius Areopagite in icons - the Athenian judge converted by Paul, this folder's saint, not Dionysius of Paris or of Alexandria.
